decisions.reason: Because the flanged dismantling joint is close to the firm's existing pipeline-components business, the firm can readily use its production and application knowledge to refine it, so despite somewhat lower website emphasis it is more likely to be retained.

The ceiling or floor pipe bracket builds directly on the firm's established metal fabrication capabilities and customer base, so the firm has strong related knowledge to learn from early market feedback and keep it in the range.
The pipe support bracket fits the firm's existing offer, equipment, and infrastructure customers well, making it a product the firm can understand, improve, and continue rather than withdraw.
